sentences.text:
The above writ petition is filed with following prayers :
i. "To issue a writ of mandamus, order or direction directing the 1st respondent to consider Ext P7 application for D & O licence submitted before the 1st respondent without insisting for consent letter from the 3rd respondent.

ii. To issue a writ of mandamus, order or direction directing the 1st respondent to consider Ext P7 application for D & O licence submitted before the 1st respondent and issue the licence to the petitioner.

iii. To issue a writ of mandamus, order or direction directing the 1st respondent to consider Ext P7 application for D & O licence submitted before the 1st respondent and issue the licence to the petitioner for catering business in Room bearing No:
19/32-21 which is categorized as commercial building iv.
Such other relief this Hon'ble court deems fit and proper to grant in the facts and circumstances of the case."

When this writ petition came up for consideration, the learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner will be satisfied if a direction is issued to the 1st respondent to consider Ext.P7 application for D&O licence, in the light of the dictum laid down by the Apex Court in Sudhakaran v. Corporation of Trivandrum and anr. [2016 (3) KHC 803].
3. Heard the Standing Counsel appearing for respondent Nos.1 and 2.
4.

entities.text: Sudhakaran v. Corporation of Trivandrum and anr. [2016 (3) KHC 803]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: After hearing both sides, I think that prayer can be allowed on condition that the Municipality should give notice to the 3rd respondent also before deciding the matter.

Therefore, this writ petition is disposed of with the following directions :
1) The 1st respondent is directed to consider Ext.P7 application, after giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and 3rd respondent as expeditiously as possible, 2025:KER:94281 at any rate, within thirty days from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.
M/S Shalom Catering vs The Secretary on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/382103/
2 2)
While deciding Ext.P7 application, the 1st respondent will consider the dictum laid down by the Apex Court in Sudhakaran's case (supra).
3) The petitioner will produce a certified copy of this judgment before the 1st respondent for compliance.

Sd/-
 P.V.KUNHIKRISHNAN
